lines.zh: 低沉的吼声回荡，地动山摇！
lines.en: Deep growl shakes the ground.

lines.zh: 脚掌落地，尘土飞扬如云雾！
lines.en: Feet hit the ground, dust rises like clouds.

lines.zh: 巨大的身躯缓慢前行，草丛摇曳生姿！
lines.en: Large body moves slowly, swaying the grass.

lines.zh: 嚼着青草，牙齿发出清脆声响！
lines.en: Grinding teeth on grass make a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 身体摇晃，仿佛带着大地一起摇摆！
lines.en: Body shakes, like the earth is moving with it.

lines.zh: 眼神凶狠，盯着玩家不放！
lines.en: Fiery eyes lock on the player.

lines.zh: 尾巴轻轻摆动，尾巴尖偶尔触地！
lines.en: Tail sways, tapping the ground occasionally.

lines.zh: 鼻孔喷出热气，仿佛能喷出岩浆！
lines.en: Nostrils steam like they might spew lava.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩过泥土，留下深深的痕迹！
lines.en: Hooves leave deep prints in the mud.

lines.zh: 啃食树叶，牙齿咔嚓作响！
lines.en: Chomping leaves, teeth click loudly.

lines.zh: 我踩着腐烂的落叶，一路碾过去。
lines.en: I trample the rotting leaves as I go.

lines.zh: 黑点在皮下一起一伏地爬。
lines.en: The black specks crawl in waves beneath my hide.

lines.zh: 每走一步，树上的鸟都飞走。
lines.en: Each step scatters the birds from the trees.

lines.zh: 我没有角，但我的体重够用。
lines.en: I have no horns, but my weight will do.

lines.zh: 粗壮的四肢静静地站立，等待猎物！
lines.en: Strong legs stand still, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 低头啃食低矮的灌木丛，不紧不慢！
lines.en: Low to the ground, munching on shrubs.

lines.zh: 悠闲地晃动着脑袋，享受着清风！
lines.en: Head swaying leisurely, enjoying the breeze.

lines.zh: 低头凝视着地面上的某处，似乎在寻找什么！
lines.en: Head lowered, searching the ground.

lines.zh: 用鼻子轻触地面，寻找美味！
lines.en: Nose touches the ground, seeking food.

lines.zh: 偶尔转动一下脑袋，调整视线！
lines.en: Head turns occasionally, adjusting gaze.

lines.zh: 眼神空洞，仿佛在回忆过往！
lines.en: Empty eyes, recalling past times.

lines.zh: 缓慢地转动身体，调整姿势！
lines.en: Body turns slowly, adjusting stance.

lines.zh: 静静站立，仿佛一尊石雕！
lines.en: Standing still, like a stone statue.

lines.zh: 目光空洞地望着远方，思索着什么！
lines.en: Empty eyes staring at the distance, pondering.

lines.zh: 我嚼着叶子，眼睛却不眨。
lines.en: I chew leaves without blinking.

lines.zh: 身上的黑点咬我，我只好发火。
lines.en: The black specks bite me, so I rage.

lines.zh: 我把长颈搭在树干上歇息。
lines.en: I rest my long neck on a trunk.

lines.zh: 我抬头够到最高的那层嫩叶。
lines.en: I raise my head to the highest young leaves.

lines.zh: 脚边被踩出一个浅坑。
lines.en: A shallow pit forms under my feet.

lines.zh: 有虫在皮下游走，我甩了甩尾。
lines.en: Bugs travel under my hide; I flick my tail.

lines.zh: 我低头嗅了嗅自己的前腿。
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff my own foreleg.

lines.zh: 远处有响动，我慢慢偏头。
lines.en: Something stirs far off; I tilt my head slowly.

lines.zh: 巨大的眼睛死死盯着玩家，威慑力十足！
lines.en: Large eyes fix on the player, intimidating.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，它似乎在思索对策！
lines.en: Hissing, it seems to be thinking.

lines.zh: 目光如炬，仿佛能洞察一切秘密！
lines.en: Glaring, as if seeing through secrets.

lines.zh: 眼神冷酷，透露出无尽的恶意！
lines.en: Cold eyes, revealing endless malice.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，好像要把对方看穿！
lines.en: Staring, as if to see through the player.

lines.zh: 目光如刀，锋利的目光锁定玩家！
lines.en: Sharp eyes, locking on the player.

lines.zh: 眼神如炬，照亮玩家的恐惧！
lines.en: Lantern eyes, lighting the player's fear.

lines.zh: 瞪大双眼，仿佛要看穿玩家的心灵！
lines.en: Wide eyes, as if seeing into the player's soul.

lines.zh: 凝视玩家，仿佛要吞食掉对方！
lines.en: Staring, as if to swallow the player.

lines.zh: 目光锐利，像要把玩家撕裂！
lines.en: Sharp gaze, as if to tear the player apart.

lines.zh: 你还没我一条腿高。
lines.en: You do not reach my knee.

lines.zh: 我眯眼看你，鼻息很响。
lines.en: I squint at you, nostrils loud.

lines.zh: 巨大的身躯晃动着，副巨犀痛苦地哀嚎。
lines.en: The huge body shudders, and the Paraceratherium howls in pain.

lines.zh: 它的皮毛在颤抖，副巨犀痛苦嘶鸣。
lines.en: Its fur trembles as the Paraceratherium roars in agony.

lines.zh: 副巨犀痛苦地喘息着，声音低沉而沉重。
lines.en: The Paraceratherium wheezes painfully, a deep and heavy sound.

lines.zh: 副巨犀摇晃着倒下，声音中满是痛苦。
lines.en: The Paraceratherium staggers and falls, its voice filled with pain.

lines.zh: 受伤的副巨犀发出悲痛的哀鸣。
lines.en: The injured Paraceratherium emits a mournful cry.

lines.zh: 副巨犀痛苦地咆哮着，声音嘶哑。
lines.en: The Paraceratherium roars in agony, its voice hoarse.

lines.zh: 受伤的副巨犀喘息着，声音嘶哑。
lines.en: The injured Paraceratherium wheezes, its voice hoarse.

lines.zh: 副巨犀痛苦地嘶吼着，声音低沉。
lines.en: The Paraceratherium roars in agony, a low voice.

lines.zh: 巨大的副巨犀痛苦地哀鸣。
lines.en: The huge Paraceratherium howls in pain.

lines.zh: 副巨犀痛苦地嘶吼，声音嘶哑。
lines.en: The Paraceratherium roars in agony, a hoarse voice.

lines.zh: 巨角抵触草，怒吼震四方！
lines.en: Butter the great horns, rumbled through the land.

lines.zh: 绿色巨人引诱你，巨响震耳欲聋！
lines.en: Green giant tempts you, echo booming in the ears.

lines.zh: 副巨犀饥渴难耐，目光如炬！
lines.en: Paraceratherium ravenous, eyes burning with hunger.

lines.zh: 巨大身躯靠近，大地颤抖不已！
lines.en: Large body near, earth trembles nonstop.

lines.zh: 副巨犀渴望食物，步步逼近！
lines.en: Paraceratherium desires food, steps closer.

lines.zh: 它身上蠕动的黑点引诱你靠近！
lines.en: The wriggling black spots lure you closer.

lines.zh: 巨大脚步声，大地在颤抖！
lines.en: Giant footsteps, earth shakes.

lines.zh: 巨角威胁，低吼如雷鸣！
lines.en: Great horns threaten, growl like thunder.

lines.zh: 你踏入了它的领地，它警告你！
lines.en: You stepped into its territory, it warns you.

lines.zh: 副巨犀的咆哮，震耳欲聋！
lines.en: Paraceratherium's roar, deafening.

lines.zh: 巨体冲撞，万物无存！
lines.en: Giant body collides, nothing remains.

lines.zh: 副巨犀狂奔，万物被碾压！
lines.en: Paraceratherium runs, all crushed.

lines.zh: 巨犀怒撞，万物粉碎！
lines.en: Paraceratherium crashes, all shatters.

lines.zh: 副巨犀怒气冲撞，万物皆破！
lines.en: Paraceratherium collides with rage, all broken.

lines.zh: 巨角撞击，万物粉碎！
lines.en: Great horns collide, all crushed.

lines.zh: 副巨犀怒撞，万物被撞飞！
lines.en: Paraceratherium collides, all fly away.

lines.zh: 巨角冲撞，万物倒塌！
lines.en: Great horns collide, all collapse.

lines.zh: 副巨犀怒撞，万物被撞散！
lines.en: Paraceratherium collides, all scatter.

lines.zh: 副巨犀怒撞，万物崩溃！
lines.en: Paraceratherium collides, all crumble.

lines.zh: 我被撞得一顿，随即发怒。
lines.en: The bump stops me short, then I seethe.

lines.zh: 副巨犀求偶，轰鸣声不断！
lines.en: Paraceratherium seeks mate, constant rumble.

lines.zh: 副巨犀求偶，轰鸣声震天！
lines.en: Paraceratherium seeks mate, rumble shakes the sky.

lines.zh: 副巨犀求偶，低吼不断！
lines.en: Paraceratherium seeks mate, constant growl.

lines.zh: 副巨犀求偶，轰鸣声震地！
lines.en: Paraceratherium seeks mate, rumble shakes the earth.

lines.zh: 副巨犀求偶，低吼如雷！
lines.en: Paraceratherium seeks mate, growl like thunder.

lines.zh: 副巨犀求偶，轰鸣声响彻天际！
lines.en: Paraceratherium seeks mate, rumble resounds through the heavens.

lines.zh: 副巨犀求偶，低吼传千里！
lines.en: Paraceratherium seeks mate, growl travels a thousand miles.

lines.zh: 副巨犀求偶，轰鸣声震耳！
lines.en: Paraceratherium seeks mate, rumble deafens.

lines.zh: 副巨犀求偶，低吼如雷鸣！
lines.en: Paraceratherium seeks mate, growl like thunder.

lines.zh: 副巨犀求偶，轰鸣声震天动地！
lines.en: Paraceratherium seeks mate, rumble shakes heaven and earth.

lines.zh: 这庞然大物怎么站在这里？
lines.en: How did this giant stand here?

lines.zh: 好大的一只草食怪兽啊
lines.en: So big a herbivore.

lines.zh: 小心，它的角太危险了
lines.en: Beware, its horns are dangerous.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤看起来很厚实
lines.en: Its skin feels very tough.

lines.zh: 这庞然大物身上蠕动着什么
lines.en: What is moving on its body?

lines.zh: 它咀嚼着什么奇怪的东西
lines.en: It's chewing on something strange.

lines.zh: 它的蹄子在地上发出响声
lines.en: Its hooves make a noise on the ground.

lines.zh: 这巨兽的吼声吓人
lines.en: Its roar is scary.

lines.zh: 它的体型让人望而生畏
lines.en: Its size is intimidating.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛似乎充满怒火
lines.en: Its eyes seem full of anger.

lines.zh: 它又注意到什么了？
lines.en: What did it notice?

lines.zh: 它在观察什么东西？
lines.en: What is it observing?

lines.zh: 它的眼神中充满敌意
lines.en: Its eyes are full of hostility.

lines.zh: 它的眼神锁定一个目标
lines.en: Its gaze is fixed on a target.

lines.zh: 它似乎要发起攻击
lines.en: It seems to be preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 它已经瞄准了猎物
lines.en: It has targeted its prey.

lines.zh: 它的角闪烁着杀气
lines.en: Its horns are glowing with aggression.

lines.zh: 它的身体开始紧张起来
lines.en: Its body is tensing up.

lines.zh: 它开始发出低吼声
lines.en: It starts growling lowly.

lines.zh: 它的毛发直立起来
lines.en: Its fur stands up.

lines.zh: 它要攻击那个东西吗？
lines.en: Is it going to attack that?

lines.zh: 它要开始行动了吗？
lines.en: Is it going to move?

lines.zh: 它要动真格了
lines.en: It's serious now.

lines.zh: 它要动了，闪开！
lines.en: It's moving, get out of the way!

lines.zh: 它开始朝你冲来
lines.en: It's coming towards you.

lines.zh: 它已经启动了
lines.en: It's set to go.

lines.zh: 它已经瞄准并冲刺了
lines.en: It's targeted and charging.

lines.zh: 它朝你来了个冲撞
lines.en: It's a headbutt.

lines.zh: 它要用巨角顶你
lines.en: It's going to use its horns.

lines.zh: 它要发起攻击了
lines.en: It's attacking.

lines.zh: 来吧，看我獠牙！
lines.en: Come on, check my fangs!

lines.zh: 用身体碾压你！
lines.en: Run over you!

lines.zh: 践踏一切靠近的！
lines.en: Trample anything nearby!

lines.zh: 巨蹄落下，草皮连同石头飞起。
lines.en: My hoof lands and turf flies up with the stones.

lines.zh: 用巨蹄踹开你！
lines.en: Kick you with my giant hooves!

lines.zh: 你的脑袋承受不住！
lines.en: Your head can't take it!

lines.zh: 用体重压垮你！
lines.en: Crush you with my weight!

lines.zh: 我低下头，用额头撞你的肋骨。
lines.en: I drop my head and drive my brow into your ribs.

lines.zh: 用力量宣示主权！
lines.en: Assert my dominance with power!

lines.zh: 前腿一落，地面凹下去！
lines.en: My foreleg comes down and the ground dents!

lines.zh: 我是巨兽！
lines.en: I am a giant!

lines.zh: 我从渐新世的雾里走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the Oligocene mist.

lines.zh: 我来了，谁怕谁？
lines.en: Here I am, who’s afraid?

lines.zh: 寻找食物，也寻找战斗。
lines.en: Seeking food, and conflict.

lines.zh: 我的脚步，无人能挡。
lines.en: My footsteps, no one can stop.

lines.zh: 黑暗带来力量。
lines.en: Darkness brings power.

lines.zh: 我是副巨犀，陆上之王。
lines.en: I am a Paraceratherium, king of the land.

lines.zh: 我的存在，就是警告。
lines.en: My presence is a warning.

lines.zh: 这里曾是我的家园。
lines.en: This was my home.

lines.zh: 我是不可侵犯的。
lines.en: I am inviolable.

lines.zh: 深板岩化石里，我长出了血肉。
lines.en: Out of deepslate fossil, flesh grew on me.

lines.zh: 培育器亮了一下，我睁开眼。
lines.en: The cultivator flickers and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 渐新世的草原没有了，我还站着。
lines.en: The Oligocene plains are gone; I still stand.

lines.zh: 黑点从我的皮里钻出来了。
lines.en: The black specks have emerged from my hide.

lines.zh: 火焰舔舐着副巨犀的皮毛，它痛苦嘶鸣。
lines.en: Fire licks the Paraceratherium's fur, and it roars in pain.

lines.zh: 副巨犀从高处摔下，重重地摔在地面。
lines.en: The Paraceratherium falls from a height and crashes to the ground.

lines.zh: 副巨犀落入水中，开始痛苦嘶鸣。
lines.en: The Paraceratherium falls into water and begins to roar in pain.

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击波击中副巨犀，它痛苦嘶鸣。
lines.en: The explosion's shockwave hits the Paraceratherium, and it roars in pain.

lines.zh: 副巨犀被投射物击中，痛苦嘶鸣。
lines.en: The Paraceratherium is hit by a projectile, and it roars in pain.

lines.zh: 魔法攻击击中副巨犀，它痛苦嘶鸣。
lines.en: A magical attack hits the Paraceratherium, and it roars in pain.

lines.zh: 副巨犀因为饥饿而虚弱，痛苦嘶鸣。
lines.en: The Paraceratherium weakens from hunger and roars in pain.

lines.zh: 雷击击中副巨犀，它痛苦嘶鸣。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the Paraceratherium, and it roars in pain.

lines.zh: 副巨犀坠入虚空，发出痛苦的哀鸣。
lines.en: The Paraceratherium falls into the void and emits a mournful cry.
